AI Engineer
Job title: AI Engineer
Department: Global Legal, Intellectual Property, and Security (GLIPS)
Company: Novo Nordisk GBS, Bangalore
Shape the future of AI at Novo Nordisk and drive transformative solutions that support life-saving work across our global legal and intellectual property operations.
The position
As an AI Engineer, you'll be at the forefront of our AI transformation journey, building and deploying cutting-edge AI solutions that create lasting impact across Novo Nordisk. This role offers the unique opportunity to work at the intersection of emerging technology and mission-critical business functions, where your technical expertise will directly enable our purpose of defeating serious chronic diseases.
Your responsibilities will include:
Building, deploying, and maintaining robust, efficient, and compliant AI-centric solutions from proof of concepts through MVPs to mature products used across Novo Nordisk
Navigating complex business domains and corporate structures to engage with technical and non-technical colleagues, helping them harness the power of AI
Staying at the forefront of the rapidly evolving AI landscape and actively contributing to shaping Novo Nordisk's AI vision and strategy
Spearheading the early adoption and utilization of novel technologies with long-term potential for our organization
Creating and driving AI and data-centric projects and initiatives with self-sufficiency and strategic thinking
Updating technical documentation, participating in team and external meetings, and actively contributing to the ideation of innovative solutions
Conveying deep technical expertise to stakeholders across all levels, making complex AI concepts accessible and actionable
Qualifications
We're searching for a highly motivated and self-driven team player with excellent communication skills who can successfully collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You'll bring with you:
A Master's degree in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, or a similar field, along with proven work experience in AI or ML/NLP
Demonstrated contribution to Agentic AI products currently in production, with deep expertise in taking AI or NLP-based applications from idea to production
Strong proficiency with Python-based, AI-centric frontend technologies such as Chainlit and Streamlit
Experience taking an AI-related startup or scaleup from early stages to maturity, including hands-on work with AI agents and multi-agent systems
Deep technical expertise across the AI stack including vector databases, data pipelines, knowledge graphs, and AI architecture
Fluency with CI/CD pipelines, preferably Github Actions, and expertise with DevOps and deployment orchestrators, particularly Kubernetes
Deep expertise with Docker-based development environments and deployments
Proficiency in MS Azure and Amazon AWS, especially their AI offerings (Azure OpenAI and Bedrock)
Familiarity with Terraform and/or cloud agnostic Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
Bonus qualifications: Experience with Google Cloud, Vector Databases, Semantic Search, and Language Models

AI Engineer - Pune, India

Full-time | Onsite

Why This Role Matters

As an AI Engineer in the AI Spark team - a focused, high impact product innovation team responsible for accelerating the adoption of AI driven capabilities across Hansen products, you will play a pivotal role in defining the next generation of Hansen s AI powered product experiences. Your work won t stay on paper it will go directly into the hands of users around the world.

This is a role for builders:

People who love shaping raw ideas into product-ready AI features
Engineers who thrive in experimental, high energy environments
Innovators who want to influence the future of AI in global industries

You ll help drive new revenue streams, explore novel AI capabilities, and bring transformational technology to life.

What You ll Do

AI Solution Design Architecture

Develop advanced AI prototypes using multi cloud platforms and large language models.
Build secure, scalable architectures that integrate into enterprise product environments.
Conduct technical reviews to ensure strong engineering, security, and compliance standards.

Engineering Execution Product Delivery

Collaborate with engineers and data scientists to implement and optimise AI agents and workflows.
Translate customer and product requirements into clear designs and engineering plans.
Evaluate emerging AI tools to keep solutions innovative and future ready.

AI Adoption Customer Empowerment

Conduct workshops and co innovation sessions to gather feedback and validate solutions.
Promote AI driven innovation by showcasing practical use cases and emerging capabilities.
Create training materials and demos to support user adoption.

Strategic Collaboration Product Impact

Identify high value AI opportunities with product and stakeholders.
Serve as a subject matter expert on AI best practices, architecture, and implementation.
Measure the impact of AI features and use insights to drive continuous improvement.

What You Bring

Skilled in working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, including multi-cloud integration.
Possesses in-depth knowledge of large language models, machine learning frameworks, and AI system architecture.
Experienced in programming languages like Python, Java, and C#.
Demonstrates strong analytical thinking and adeptness at solving problems related to complex system designs.
Has a background in DevOps and deploying scalable artificial intelligence solutions.
Excels in communication and teamwork across different functional groups.
Well-versed in enterprise-level security, compliance measures, and data governance practices.

Preferred:

1-2+ years of experience in AI engineering (in-house or consulting).
Strategic mindset with ability to turn vision into actionable steps.

AI / Agentic AI Engineer - Enterprise Observability

Overview

The Enterprise Observability team is responsible for monitoring, maintaining, and improving the health of critical banking applications, services, and infrastructure. As observability platforms generate massive volumes of metrics, events, logs, traces, and synthetic monitoring data, operational teams require intelligent solutions to identify, correlate, and remediate issues rapidly.

We are seeking an experienced AI / Agentic AI Engineer to design and develop next-generation AI-powered observability solutions that transform operational monitoring into proactive, intelligent, and increasingly autonomous systems.

This role will focus on building Agentic AI and RAG-based platforms capable of analyzing operational telemetry data, accelerating incident investigations, reducing alert fatigue, recommending corrective actions, and enabling self-healing capabilities across enterprise banking environments.

Key Responsibilities

Agentic AI Development

Design and develop enterprise-scale Agentic AI solutions for observability and operational workflows.
Build autonomous and semi-autonomous agents capable of incident investigation and remediation.
Implement multi-agent frameworks using LangGraph, LangChain, Microsoft AutoGen, and OpenAI Agents SDK.
Develop AI orchestration workflows that support operational decision-making.

RAG & Knowledge Engineering

Design Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures for operational intelligence.
Build and manage enterprise knowledge repositories and incident knowledge bases.
Develop solutions leveraging vector databases such as:
Azure AI Search
Pinecone
Weaviate
ChromaDB
Implement incident knowledge graphs and context-aware retrieval systems.

Observability & AIOps

Analyze Metrics, Events, Logs, Traces, and Synthetics (MELTS) data across multiple observability platforms.
Develop AI-driven root cause analysis and anomaly detection solutions.
Create intelligent alert correlation and incident prioritization mechanisms.
Enable proactive issue detection and predictive analytics capabilities.

Automation Engineering

Develop operational runbooks and automated remediation workflows.
Build self-healing automation solutions using:
Python
PowerShell
REST APIs
Workflow orchestration tools
Integrate AI systems with observability and IT operations platforms.
Drive improvements in operational efficiency and Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR).

Stakeholder Collaboration

Partner with Observability, SRE, Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, and Operations teams.
Translate business and operational requirements into AI-powered solutions.
Contribute to strategic initiatives focused on operational resilience and service reliability.

Required Skills & Experience

Core Technical Skills

Strong experience in Agentic AI solution development.
Expertise in LangChain, LangGraph, Microsoft AutoGen, Azure AI Foundry, and OpenAI Agents SDK.
Hands-on experience designing and implementing RAG architectures.
Experience with vector databases including Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, or Azure AI Search.
Strong programming skills in Python.

Automation & Integration

Experience building remediation workflows and operational automation solutions.
Hands-on experience with REST APIs and orchestration frameworks.
Knowledge of PowerShell and automation scripting.

Observability & Operations

Understanding of observability concepts including Metrics, Logs, Events, Traces, and Synthetic Monitoring.
Experience supporting AIOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), IT Operations, or Platform Engineering environments.
Knowledge of incident management and operational excellence practices.

Preferred Qualifications

Banking or Financial Services experience.
Experience with Enterprise Observability platforms.
Knowledge of SRE, AIOps, and IT Service Management (ITSM) environments.
Experience building AI solutions for operational intelligence or production support organizations.
Exposure to cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.

Design and implement ML models for anomaly detection, predictive failure analysis, and connector health monitoring.
Build and deploy supervised and unsupervised learning pipelines for IT operations analytics and AIOps use cases.



Required Candidate profile

hands-on experience in ML model development, LLM/GenAI application engineering, NLP pipelines,
automation frameworks, and cloud-native AI integration on AWS.
